# dodopayments_addon (List Resource)

Finds addons to import with `terraform query`.

-> List resources need Terraform 1.14 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Run "terraform query -generate-config-out=generated.tf" to write a resource block and an import block for each object.
list "dodopayments_addon" "all" {
  provider         = dodopayments
  include_resource = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) List archived addons. The default is false.
